Meta.title: {brand}: 24/7 towing in Peja and across Kosovo
Meta.description: 24/7 towing and roadside assistance, car transport within Kosovo and car import from Germany, Switzerland and Austria. Instant online quote.

ActionBar.label: Quick actions
ActionBar.locationError: We couldn't get your location. Allow location access or call us.
ActionBar.whatsappText: Hello, I need help with my vehicle.
ActionBar.locationText: Hello, I need a tow. My location: {link}

Hero.title: Towing and car transport, whenever you need it
Hero.subtitle: From Peja across Kosovo, and from Europe to your door. We arrive in {minutes} minutes on average.
Hero.emergencyText: Broken down or had an accident? Call or send your location with one tap.
Hero.plannedText: Transport within Kosovo or import from Germany, Switzerland, Austria. See your price instantly.

Services.title: Our services
Services.emergencyTowingText: Accident, engine failure, car won't start: we come day and night.
Services.roadsideText: Battery, tyre, fuel, lockout and winch recovery.
Services.domesticText: City to city, to the garage, or to the new owner.
Services.internationalText: Germany, Switzerland, Austria → Kosovo, with customs and export plate help.

Trust.title: Why customers choose us
Trust.insuredText: Every vehicle is insured while in our care.

Consent.title: Cookies
Consent.text: We use necessary cookies to make the site work. With your permission we also use analytics and marketing cookies.

Quote.metaTitle: Instant towing and car transport quote
Quote.title: Get an instant price
Quote.intro: Enter where we pick up and deliver. You see an estimated price straight away.
Quote.noPrice: We need a moment to price this. Book anyway and the operator will confirm the price by phone, usually within 15 minutes.
Quote.noCoordinates: Pick the addresses from the suggestions so we can calculate the distance, or book and we'll call you with a price.
Quote.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
Quote.error: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us.

Booking.title: Book
Booking.draftSaved: Your progress is saved on this device.
Booking.vinHelp: 17 characters, found on the registration document.
Booking.conditionPlaceholder: e.g. front damage, does not start, flat tyre
Booking.photosHelp: Take photos with your camera or choose from the gallery. Up to 8.
Booking.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. You can continue without it.
Booking.photosUnavailable: Photo upload is not available right now. You can send photos on WhatsApp after booking.
Booking.phoneHelp: We call or message this number about your order.
Booking.privacyConsent: I have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and agree that my data is used to carry out this order.
Booking.marketingConsent: Send me occasional offers (optional, you can unsubscribe any time).

errors.phone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. 044 123 456.
errors.vin: A VIN has 17 letters and digits (no I, O or Q).
errors.year: Enter a year between 1950 and next year.
errors.before_start: The latest date must be after the earliest date.
errors.bot: We could not verify the form. Please try again or call us.
errors.rate_limited: Too many bookings from this connection. Please call us.
errors.server: The booking could not be sent. Please try again or call us.

Booking.doneText: Thank you. Your order number is {number}. An operator will confirm the final price shortly.
Booking.doneSave: Keep this number. You need it together with your phone number to track the order.

twofa.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
